# A slot's render that raises draws again on the next write. The render of
# the `for` reads labels(n), which raises at 1. The render's re-entry guard
# (__renderingN) was cleared after the loop, which the raise skipped, so every
# later render was taken for a re-entry and the list stayed as the raise left
# it. It is cleared in a finally now (ir.If.Finally, lower's renderOnce).
#
# The raise is the render's, so the boundary around the loop hears it
# (lower's passRenderCatch), on every target: it rendered inside the click's
# handler on html, fyne and gtk4, whose catch block took it, after the
# handler on the interpreter and bubbletea, where no boundary was told, and
# while Compose composed on android, where it reached no catch block at all.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func labels(n int) list[string] {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return ["n{n}"]
}

func check(n int) {
    if n > 100 {
        error.raise("too many", "bad")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var caught = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        caught = e.message
    }) {
        ui.button #step(text="step", @click {
            n += 1
            check(n)
        })
        for var l = labels(n) {
            ui.text #shown(value=l)
        }
    }
}

func testARenderDrawsAgainAfterARaise(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.shown[0] != null && c.shown[0].value == "n0")
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 1)
    t.assert(c.caught == "one is refused")
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.shown[0] != null && c.shown[0].value == "n2")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
